Opt in to OCR elements to get each word's text, bounding box and confidence

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using Xberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var result = await XbergConverter.ExtractAsync(new ExtractInput { Kind = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ExtractInputKind>("\"uri\"", ConfigOptions)!, MimeType = "image/png", Uri = "https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png" }, new ExtractionConfig { ForceOcr = true, Ocr = new OcrConfig { Backend = "tesseract", ElementConfig = new OcrElementConfig { IncludeElements = true, MinLevel = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<OcrElementLevel>("\"word\"", ConfigOptions)! }, Enabled = true, Language = new List<string>() { "eng" } } });
Console.WriteLine(result.Results[0].OcrElements);
```
